session_id.Description: A session identifier of the form ses-<label>, indicating the recording session (NWB file) for this cell in the dataset.

participant_id.Description: The participant (Donor) this cell came from, of the form sub-<label>. Corresponds to participant_id in participants.tsv.

cell_specimen_id.Description: Allen Institute LIMS specimen identifier of the recorded cell.

dissociated_cell_sample_local_name.Description: Human-readable local name of the Dissociated Cell Sample (the recorded cell).

brain_structure_acronym_dhba.Description: Acronym, in the Developing Human Brain Atlas (DHBA) ontology, of the brain structure the recorded cell was located in.

patched_cell_container.Description: Allen Institute LIMS name of the container holding the patched cell's extracted contents.

exp_component_name.Description: Allen Institute LIMS name of the sequencing experiment component for this cell.

library_prep.Description: Allen Institute LIMS name of the sequencing library preparation for this cell.

dandi_file_url.Description: DANDI Archive asset download URL for the NWB data file associated with this session in this dataset.

source_dandiset_id.Description: The source Dandiset the NWB file was originally uploaded to. Corresponds to dandiset_id in datasets.tsv.

source_dandi_file_url.Description: DANDI Archive asset download URL for the same NWB file in its source Dandiset.
